import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 4

def design(feats):
    # Check for significant associations
    sig_features = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if feats.types[i] == 'derived':
            continue
        x = feats.x[:, i]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0])
        if p_val < 0.05 and abs(t_stat) > 2.0:
            sig_features.append((fid, t_stat, p_val))
    
    # Sort by significance
    sig_features.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    keep = []
    for fid, _, _ in sig_features:
        is_dup = False
        for kept_fid in keep:
            if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, feats.column(kept_fid)], 
                              feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)])[0,1]) > 0.6:
                is_dup = True
                break
        if not is_dup:
            keep.append(fid)
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if len(keep) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Check stratum consistency
    stratum_consistent = True
    if len(set(feats.stratum)) > 1:
        stratum_consistent = False
        # Test each stratum separately
        unique_strata = set(feats.stratum)
        for stratum in unique_strata:
            mask = [s == stratum for s in feats.stratum]
            stratum_x = feats.x[mask]
            stratum_y = feats.y[mask]
            if len(stratum_y) > 10:  # minimum sample size
                # Test for association in this stratum
                for fid in keep[:5]:  # test top features
                    col_idx = feats.column(fid)
                    x = stratum_x[:, col_idx]
                    t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[stratum_y==1], x[stratum_y==0])
                    if p_val < 0.05 and abs(t_stat) > 2.0:
                        stratum_consistent = True
                        break
    
    # Return based on significance and stratum consistency
    if not stratum_consistent:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Select top features for modeling
    drivers = tuple(f for f in keep[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    columns = tuple(f for f in keep[:10])
    
    # Build loadings (simple weighted sum of top features)
    loadings = {}
    for fid in columns:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0])
        loadings[fid] = t_stat / len(columns)  # normalized weight
    
    # Build products (interactions between top features)
    products = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(columns[:3]):
        for fid2 in columns[i+1:i+3]:
            products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
